### 2026-10-11 – I know the time lapse submitted is only 2 hours, but I didn't record the fact that I had to watch like 4 YouTube videos and stuff to understand what I was doing. Some things that went wrong were uploa

**6h**

I know the time lapse submitted is only 2 hours, but I didn't record the fact that I had to watch like 4 YouTube videos and stuff to understand what I was doing. Some things that went wrong were uploading the Week 1 care package and the PCB editor, which didn't transfer things properly. Also, the thing that I liked was the schematic editor; it was really fun, and I enjoyed it. Thanks for this opportunity. A thing i recommend is to add links to the YouTube videos that would be helpful.
